parole.significato: A directive given (usually to dogs or a horse) to start moving, or to move faster.
parole.testo: Believed to be a contraction of mush on, from Michif, in turn a corruption of French marche (“march”) or marchons!, the cry of voyageurs and coureurs de bois to their dogs. parole.significato: A basic stew or porridge based on peas and/or corn.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Michif rubaboo, from French roux (“thickener”) + Proto-Algonquian *aboo (“soup”). Compare Ojibwe naboo (“soup”), -aaboo (“liquid”).
